title: Interfaces
explain: An interface lists methods a class promises to provide, and a class can implement many interfaces. Code that depends on the interface works with any implementation, which makes it easy to swap or test. Since Java 8, interfaces can also carry `default` methods with a body.
exercise: Make a `Circle` that implements `Shape` and print both shapes from a `List<Shape>`.
tip: Interface methods are public automatically. When you implement one you must write `public` too, or the code won't compile.
